balls.text: slower on the middle stump and he cannot hit it too well, off the toe of the bat back to the bowler who lobs it back at the non-striker's end where the batsman has taken a start and is easily run-out

out, run-out! slower delivery and he's not going to stop going after it, the slowness beats him too and it's gone high but it's in the gap between the long-off and deep cover, both the fielders converge, one of them, Binny stops it on the bounce and flicks it to the other, Baby, who rips a strong throw at the non-striker's end where the bails are whipped off, the batsmen were going for the third and is run-out!
fuller and wants to muscle it away, hits it straight to long-off for a single
wants to hit away again but misses, they come across for a bye
was looking to go across to outside the off stump and then it was bowled further outside the off, gets an outside edge and it lobs up to the deep cover fielder, dropped there I think
fuller outside the off and he's drilled it down to long-off for a single

bowled him, five-for James Faulkner, his second of this IPL and against the same opponent! this was a very full ball, and on the middle stump, Steyn was looking to play it across the line and misses, the stump gets a fair hit and it's lying on the ground
fuller outside the off and can only drill it to long-off for a single
full-toss, angling back into the batsman and he tries to slog it over the mid-wicket region, it can go only over the bowler, not too quick and they are able to come back for the second
outside the off stump, quite outside in fact and that's given a wide

caught, at long-on, fourth one for Faulkner! was a slower one from back of the hand, it seems to have gripped and his aggressive shot it defeated by the lack of pace, does not get as much power as he would have liked and it's gone to Cooper, who takes a decent catch there
well bowled that, very full and does not give him any room to swing his arm, the bowler gets down in time to field that one
outside the off stump and the batsman throws his bat at it, gets bit of an outside edge and it rolls over to square third-man

outside edged through to third-man, he was looking to unwind as you would expect, wasn't quite in his slot and the outside edge runs to third-man for a single, Hodge was rushing in and manages to get his hand in the way
keeps it pitched right up to the bat and that's tapped down to long-on for a single
full-toss again, outside the off stump, and he has smashed it through extra-cover to the fence, good, good shot
that's a poor delivery, full-toss outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat and hits it through to the deep covers, gets a couple of runs to bring up his maiden 50, well done!
fuller on the off stump and punched down the ground for a single
full-toss, quicker and outside the off stump, punched to wide long-off and would you believe it, Watson's midfielded that one too, couple of runs now
fullish on the middle stump and punched down to long-off for a single
yet again he's bowled right up to the bat, probably a touch slower and he's hit it to wide long-off for a couple
fuller on the off stump and easily driven to the wide long-off region, they get a single and put the pressure on the fielder for the second, Cooper misfields and they come back
on his pads but this is quite full and he tries to flick it away, hits pads and rolls over for a leg-bye

wants to go over the top but is caught! that's on a length and he wants to smack it over the long-off fielder, gave himself some room too there but does not come off the middle and Hodge takes a very good catch coming in
short of length on the leg stump, pats it to the square-leg for a single
he gets it off the middle now, length ball and Sammy gives it his all, over the deep mid-wicket area for a maximum!
and now a shorter one, was probably looking for the yorker again but this one pegs him back, was looking to pull it away but gets a top-edge
whoa, what a ball, that was one of the best yorkers you would see, pacy and in the batting crease, Sammy had to get his bat down in time there
slows the pace down and he opens the face of the bat through to the third-man
edged for a four, it's come off the bottom of the bat there, and its beaten the keeper, short of length and he gives it his all, gets only a thin edge to the fence
and thumped over the bowler's head, it was a length ball and he hits it to the straightish long-on fieder
and now wanted to go down the track but he takes the pace off the ball, needs to check his shot and it rolls over to square-leg for a single
shorter in length and tucked away to the square-leg for a single this time
moves across to the leg side and he flicks it over the leg side for a couple of runs, Faulkner throws it at the non-striker's end but misses the stumps, thought it was out had it hit
and again, they seem to have decided they will go after Sid but for now they are not getting it away too well, wasn't too quick and he wanted to pull it away, does not get his timing
on his pads this time and quicker too, was looking to flick it away but hits his pads and rolls away for a leg-bye
wow, that's a fair thwack! it was on the shorter side alright but he does not move his feet at all, just stands and then delivers it over the deep mid-wicket field
shorter in length, slower in pace and he hams his bat down, loops up to the point fielder
and wants to give that one a fair thwack as well, was looking to swing it again but can only drive it down to long-on for a single
on a length and he tucks it down to deep square-leg, not hit too hard and they come back for the second, the throw was a poor one and Samson has to dive to collect it
tonked, that's hit hard as you can get on this pitch without getting a six, was slower one too and he clears the front leg and smashes it over the bowler
fuller, slower and he drives it down the ground for an easy single
on his pads and not quick enough, was looking to play it away to deep square-leg but misses, the keeper fumbles as well and it rolls over for a couple of leg-byes
shorter in length and that's pushed down to long-on for a single
as looking to go back that time and probably unwind, but quickly brings his bat down when he sees its fuller, tapped to the leg side for a single
slower one and he waits on it, taps it through square-leg for a single and by the time Faulkner runs into the ball, they come back for the second
was looking to cramp him for room, was on his pads this time and flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
length ball on the of stump and he has a nice flair going for him while driving it through to deep covers, single though
slows it down considerably that one, straighter one and he manages to get some bat on it to the leg side for a single
ooh, beaten, fuller and spun away, he was looking to defend at it, beats the outside edge
poor ball down the leg side, it was quite wide there and the keeper is lucky it was a loopy, slower one, gets his hand on it
up and over short extra-cover for a four, there was this shot attempted earlier but this one comes off the middle of the bat and goes to the fence
shorter in length and punched down to long-on for a single
down the leg side, was quicker and did not turn too much, beats the bat but seems to have come off the pads according to the umpire
shorter in length and he is looking to go back and give it a tap, hits it to mid-off
slower one, on the middle-stump and tucked away to the leg-side for a couple of runs, it's the fine-leg who has to come around to field that one
fuller on the off stump and driven down to mid-off
ooh, beaten, it was outside the off stump and seems to have kept low, beats the outside edge

leading edge and caught! it was on his pads and he was looking to flick it away to the leg side, the ball did not seem to come on to the bat and the leading edge goes quite high there, comes down safely into the laps of Baby
poor shot that, was on a length and he was looking to pull it without going on his back foot, gets some bounce too and beats the outside edge
on his pads, he gives himself room to move towards the leg side and drives it to mid-on for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven to long-on for a single
slower one, in fact it's so slow he actually adjusted his shot, done well too, at the 11th hour, he rolls his wrist over a deft touch through to fine third-man
wants to play a shot in anger, was full enough to go for it, but gets an outside edge through to third-man
short of length outside the off stump and easily opens the face of the bat and plays it down to third-man for a single
pitches a lot fuller this time and that's tapped down to mid-on
shorter in length and not too pacy, pushed to the leg side for a single
quicker on his pads, on the middle stump actually but he was moving across and is able to push it away to the leg side for a single
slower one outside the off stump and that's flicked away to wide long-on for a couple of runs
fuller outside the off stump and driven straight to the short extra-cover fielder
edged and it runs away to the fine third-man fielder where Watson comes around and rips it in, close to the stumps but the batsman's in by then
on his pads this time and that's flicked to deep square-leg for a single
short of length outside the off and he wants to push it away, gets an inside edge but luckily for him it's far from the stumps
fuller on the middle stump, was looking to defend at it and the inside edge rolls over to the mid-wicket area, gets a single
fuller on the off stump and he sweeps it away, drilled straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder
defended to the off side off one that's up to the bat
down the leg side, he was looking to flick it away, got sucked into going down for a drive, gets a pad on it, else was a chance for a stumping
up and over, was looking to play it through extra-cover but gets it as far as wide long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and defended off the front foot to the off side
slower ball and fuller too, easily picked by the batsman and on-driven through to wide long-on for a couple
and he continues to swing away from the batsman, gets it straight to the point fielder where Rahane fields well
shorter in length outside the off, pushes it into the covers
and that's the second boundary of the innings, on a length and moving away from the batsman, deliberately gets it fine to third-man for a four
opens the face and guides it to third-man for a run
shorter in length and swinging away, he comes down the track and drives it through the covers
short of length and gets bit of nip back, was looking to play it away to the leg side but is beaten, hits the pads and rolls over to the off side, not for runs
slightly fuller this time and driven to wide mid-on for a single this time
slightly shorter in length and nurdled away to the mid-wicket fielder for a single
length ball, cramping him for any room, straighter too and he has no option but to play it in front of the pads and flick it to the leg side for a single
angles back into the batsman, was on a good length but does not come on too quickly and he pushes it to square-leg for a single
short in length on the off stump, was looking to tap it away to the off side, does it too but it's not in the gap
outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat and guides it through backward point for a couple of runs
down the leg side, again not too much turn, flatter too and called a wide
quicker, the top-spinner probably, angles in and hits his pads, was looking to flick it away but misses
on his pads, slightly quicker and tucked it to square-leg for a single
up and over, that was on the off stump, right in the slot, he moves away to give himself room and despite the turn away, gets it over the field
fuller on his pads this time, wants to flick it away but hits his pads
shorter in length and turning away, easily tapped away to the leg-side for a single
slower one on his pads and he wants to flick it away, the slowness of the delivery beats the bat and it rolls over to the leg side
outside the off stump and on a good length, gets his bat and pad out, pushes it through backward point for a single
outside edge and it rushes away to the third-man fielder for a single
another bouncer which has gone down the leg-side for a wide, that was swinging away from the batsman who was looking to hook it away, missed
short of length outside the off stump and he's pushed it to the covers
bouncer and he goes under, good, surprise delivery and well played too, went under it pretty nicely
and again, misses the outside edge, was a length ball and angling away from the bat, there was no foot movement and he hung his bat out to dry, no nick though
ooh, almost an edge, it was swinging away from the bat and looks to fish away from the body, misses the outside edge through to the keeper
outside the off stump and moving away from the bat, lets it go through to the keeper

gone, third wicket, White's hooked it to fine-leg! was a short of length delivery and it was White's first delivery, he seemed to have gone for the hook rather reflexively and hits it to the fielder, who had to move a little to his left and take it high, does well!
on his pads and tucks it away to fine-leg for a single to get off the mark off his sixth ball
ooh, that's angled back into the batsman and it keeps quite low, defended back to the bowler, off the toe of the bat
shorter in length and on the off stump, defended back to the bowler

and gone again! two wickets for Faulkner, Dhawan's hit it straight to the point fielder, two down! was on a length and the batsman was looking to drive it on the up, gets the outer half of the bat and it runs to the right of the point fielder
fuller on the off stump line and he goes for a whacking drive, but it's a packed field on that side and goes to Baby
and that's a quicker on his pads, thuds into his pads and rolls over to the leg side for a single
whoa, beaten, this was on a length, not as full and he was looking to defend at it but he was neither forward nor back and goes through
fuller on the off stump and driven to mid-off
bowled him, inside edge and PP's gone! was short of length outside the off stump and he was trying to steer it down to third-man, gets only an inside edge on to the stumps and it's rattled
on a length outside the off stump and he taps it to the point fielder, they are off for a quick single
fuller on the middle stump and it's gently tapped to deep mid-wicket for a single
fuller on the middle and tapped away to short mid-wicket for the first run of the evening
looks to go down the track but he cramps him for room and flicked away to short fine-leg
very full, right up to the bat from round the stumps and drilled to the short cover
round the stumps, on his pads, shorter in length, and pulled to squareleg
short of length outside the off and he looks to poke at it, beaten, Hyderabad have won it comfortably in the end
fuller on the middle and it's tapped to the deep mid-wicket area for a single
and again, he throws his bat at it and gets the toe of the bat through to the deep point fielder, who takes a straight-forward catch
gives himself and absolutely tonks it through wide long-off, Sammy rushes across to stop it and it's gone through him here, poor effort from the fielder
and four more for Cooper, fuller outside the off stump and slices it over point for a four
yorker length, a tad too full and he takes it as a full-toss and drills it through the covers
a slower ball and that's clubbed to long-on for a single
and now he's hit over the in-field behind square for a four, it was fuller and gets some width again, the thick edge takes it to the vacant deep third-man area
quicker and yorker length, he manages to get some bat on it and rolls across to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple
and swings across the line this time, is a very slow ball and that's beaten him, through to the keeper
tonked it away and for a six! it was a very full ball and he's give it his all, the width of the delivery allows him to swing it away and gets it over deep cover
on the off stump and he's merely pushed it to White at short cover and gone for a quick one, bit of a fumble by the fielder allows them to go through
on his pads and flicked away to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump and on a length, it's defended to the covers
was shorter in length and the batsman was looking to fend away, gets some bat on it to the point fielder
outside the off stump and pushed to the point fielder
it's full, it's fast and it's swinging in, just gets his bat down in time and lobs up in front of the short mid-wicket fielder
bowled him, that's sent the off stump on a cart-wheel, it was outside the off and on a length, he had no option but to cut it, wasn't that quick and it sneaks through and hits the off, another down
shortens his length and that's tapped to long-on for a couple of runs, the fielder had to run wide and into it
fuller and on the middle, driven back to the bowler
moves around to the off side and sweeps it well, but gets it away to the backward square-leg fielder for a single
and this time he's caught, was attempting to play that same stroke yet again, what it does is to get a leading edge that carries to long-off for a simple catch
whoa, slog swept by the new man for a six over deep square-leg, it was flatter one and he smacks it
fuller on the middle stump and turning away, presses out the turn and taps to the off side for a single
fuller, tossed right up to the bat and he brings his bat and pad out and defends it back to the bowler

gone there, given lbw to a reverse sweep! he had no option but to go for the runs, he was looking to reverse it but gets no bat on it, it dips on the batsman and hits his pads, loud appeal follows and ump rules it in the favour of the bowler
flatter, quicker and on his pads, tapped to the leg side for a quickly taken couple of runs
and again! tosses it up, slows it down and beats the outside edge
and again, was a wrong 'un this time, wanted to pull it away but is beaten by a mile
googly that, or probably an offie, either way it turns away from the bat and he taps it to the leg side
shorter in length and easily tapped away to the deep square-leg region for a single
that's a lot of bounce from a length, was looking to go back to cut but can only dab it down
fullish from the bowler, looks to defend off the front foot, defended with the ball hitting the pads
on pads, spinning into the batsman and tucked away for a single
tapped away and goes for a quick single
bowled him, two of them, the stumps are lying scattered now!it's on a length and he was looking to play it across, misses it completely and the off and the middle stumps gets a solid knocking
short of length and it's been cut hard through point for a four, beats the in-fielder and the deep cover fielder cannot get to it either
on a good length and bit of movement back into the batsman, defended to the off side
gone, caught, that's the end of Watson! was a short of length delivery, he looks to hit it over wide long-on but does not get it off the middle and Sammy's caught him there
on-drives and in the air to deep square-leg where there's a fielder who restricts it to a single
slower one outside the off stump and he loves playing it down to third-man for a single
and easily guides it away to the third-man for a single
outside the off stump, not too quick off the pitch and he gently taps it to third-man for a single
that's a change in line this time, quite closer to the body, fuller on the middle stump and flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
shortish in length this time and he opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
and wow, this one swings away from the batsman, he was looking to cut and beats the batsman, what's more it beats the keeper too and they go through for a run, wide called too
length ball again and on the off stump, he looks to open the face of the bat and dab it to the off side for a single
short of length on the off stump and taps it to third-man for a single
huge appeal for a catch in the slips, but it seems to have come off the pads, it was a googly and beats the inside edge of the bat, hits the pad and lobs up to the slip, Sammy appeals hard and long.

gone, caught, straight to the long-off fielder! floats it up to the bat and entices it go over the top, he opens his stance a little but cannot get as much power as he would have wanted, straight to Steyn at long-off, three down now
that's very short from the bowler but turning away, Watson does not cut it this time, wants to pull it but can get it away to long-on only
that's very short from the bowler and he has the license to cut that one, does it hard but straight to the cover fielder
shorter in length and he looks to cut it away again, does not get it off the middle this time and it rolls across to the off side
on a length on the off stump and tapped through to the off side for a single
outside the off and well hit through backward point for a single, Steyn runs across to stop the second but Watson wants to come back, he does that despite a strong throw from the South African
good shot that, he was walking across the stumps and the bowler sends it down fuller on the middle stump, gets his bat down and flicks it to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and on a length, opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
ooh, bit of swing back into the batsman, he was looking to play it to the leg side but misses, hits the pads
on a length and outside the off stump, he defends it to the off side off the front foot
shorter in length and he opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
fuller from Mishra and driven back by Watson, not for runs though
floats it right up to the bat and that's defended to the off side
fuller on the middle stump, defended back to the bowler
tosses it up slightly more and spin away, pushed to the off side for a single
not too full, he comes forward before tapping it to the off side
shorter in length and cut it away to the deep cover for a single
fuller on his middle stump and he easily drives it down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and tapped to the off side for a single, off the back foot this one

goes down the track and hits it straight to the deep cover fielder! it was tossed up and he goes down the pitch to hit it over wide long-off but slices it more towards the deep extra-cover fielder, a scratchy knock comes to an end
fuller on the middle stump and that's flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single, Rahane wanted the second, Watson did not
fuller this time and Watto gets his bat and pad out and defends it to the off side
it's on a length outside the off and he wants to go back and cut it, bounces a tad more on him
fullish from the bowler outside the off and driven back to the bowler
very full from the bowler and hits the pads, there's a huge appeal for Patel but Mishra does not appeal
fuller on his pads and he wants to sweep it away, straight to short fine-leg

gone, run-out, Dravid's walking back! shorter in length and he pushes it to the off, they go for a single but a misfield by the bowler followed by a good fielding effort from White and a direct hit at the non-striker's end sees Dravid out, by some distance too!
shortens his length again and Dravid's gone on to the back foot and flicked it to deep mid-wicket, Sammy misfields and they comes back for the second
its slightly shorter and Dravid goes back to punch it to short cover
slows it down again, 96.5 km/hr and it's outside the off stump, taps it to short third-man for a single
wow and some bounce now, it was on a length and rears up on Rahane, wasn't at too much pace and he taps it to the leg side
slows it down drastically but Dravid still waits and cuts it well to the deep point fielder for a single
shorter in length and flicked it away to the backward square-leg area for a single, but wait there's bit of a misfield at deep square-leg and they come back for the second
goes down the track to try and bring some power on it, can only get it up to long-on for a single
on a good length and he's quickly on to his back foot, tapped away to mid-wicket for a single
on a length and wow, what a shot, this is pushed and finds the gap on the off side for a couple of runs
short of length and outside the off stump, this one has bounced a lot more than he expected and he wants to go for a drive, misses the outside edge
136.6 km/hr but it seems like it never arrived, gets bit of the bat and it rolls over to the off side
shortish in length yet again and he was looking to flick it away, but bounces more than he thought it would, rolls off the pads to third-man for a single
was giving himself room to play it over but then checks his shot and hits it to mid-off, he has a shy at the stumps does Perera and misses at the non-striker's end, Dravid looked just out
shorter in length and it's kept low yet again, beats the bat through to the keeper
defended back to the bowler this time, bit of a leading edge
and that's now been slapped for a four, it was shorter in length and that's hit in the air for a long time, through backward point but beats all the fielders there
shortens the length and flicked away to the leg side for a single
wow, that's come off the middle of the bat, sounded so good too, slog-swept over mid-wicket and it goes all the way, was a wrong 'un too
fuller on the off stump and driven to wide long-off for a single
slower, shorter and easily goes back and punches it to the covers for a single, a diving Dhawan does well
shorter in length, just does not come on to the bat as he looks to go down the track and punch it through the covers, straight to White
shorter in length but it keeps low, is able to flick it away to square-leg
the good length bowling continues around the off stump channel and the captain can only knock it to the covers
shorter in length and he's on his back foot, taps it to square-leg for a single
shorter in length and outside the off stump, he wants to cut it and this time gets it off the middle, the fielder at point does well to get to it
on a good length outside the off stump, Rahane pushes it to the off side this time
bouncer and he goes under it and lets it go through
bouncer now and Rahane wasn't expecting that one feels, gets a bit of bat to wade it away to fine-leg and now Steyn sends him his regards while he is completing the single
and keeps low again and the verbals are on! it was outside the off stump at pace, he was looking to defend from the back foot and sneaks under his bat, lot of words at Rahane who stares back
wow, he's cranking them up here and having a go at the batsman too, was on the off stump line and swinging away, looks to leave it and Steyn has a word with Rahane
shorter in length and he's quickly on to his back foot, tapped away to the leg side this time
not the best of deliveries, was on the pads but his pace is good and he only manages to flick it to fine-leg for a single
on a length again but adjusts his line to outside the off stump, pokes at it and gets an inside edge to fine-leg for a single
fuller on the middle stump, wasn't a bad ball but Dravid times it through mid-wicket for a four, a graceful looking push that earns him four!
hooked away for a six! this was shorter from Ishant and Dravid goes after it, gets a top-edge and it goes a long way over fine-leg for a maximum
on a length and Dravid's on his back foot and defends it to the off side
length ball on the off stump and punches it to short cover, that's come off the middle of the bat and White's doing the diving to his right, saves it
a good length ball from Ishant which makes the batsman almost grope at it, gets bit of an inside edge to the leg side
shorter in length and he was looking to play it down to third-man, bounces a tad higher than he expects but does well to tap it away
length ball on his pads and rolls his wrist over it, flicked it to fine-leg for a single
and now a bouncer under which he goes, did not have too many difficulties playing that, was a good ball and a pacy one at 145 km/hr
fuller this time and he defends it to the off-side, was swinging away from the batsman again
ooh, shorter in length and it disappeared in the pitch, never came up and the batsman's looking puzzled by it
swing away from the batsman and he guides it to third-man for a single
